name: zinput_mouse_shutdown_device
description: zInput::Mouse_ShutdownDevice deactivates the DirectInput mouse, unacquires it through the shared acquire-state helper, releases the device when present, clears the device and initialized globals, and returns 1.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
The DirectInput Release call is a provider vtable slot at offset 0x08.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x470360 validates clearing g_zInput_MouseActive, calling zInput::Mouse_UpdateAcquireState, conditionally calling the device vtable Release slot 0x08, clearing g_zInput_MouseDevice and g_zInput_MouseInitialized, and returning 1.
The dependency frontier for 0x470360 has no visible source blockers; zInput::Mouse_UpdateAcquireState is accepted functional evidence.
The native smoke verifies release, cleared device/initialized/active state, and return value against a fake DirectInput mouse provider.
